mapper.sql: id, model, context_limit, modalities, pricing_entry_id, status, note, operator, create_time, update_time
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO mcp_model_catalog (model, context_limit, modalities, pricing_entry_id, status, note, operator, update_time) VALUES (#{model}, #{contextLimit}, #{modalities}, #{pricingEntryId}, #{status}, #{note}, #{operator}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP)
mapper.update: UPDATE mcp_model_catalog SET context_limit = #{contextLimit}, modalities = #{modalities}, pricing_entry_id = #{pricingEntryId}, status = #{status}, note = #{note}, operator = #{operator}, update_time = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE model = #{model}
mapper.select: SELECT FROM mcp_model_catalog ORDER BY model
